# Journal of Marketing & Social Research

> > A peer-reviewed open-access academic journal dedicated to publishing rigorous research in marketing and social sciences with international editorial standards.

JMSR is an international academic journal managed by the Asian Society of Management & Marketing Research (ASMMR) based in Coimbatore. The journal follows COPE and ICMJE standards for ethical publishing and peer review, welcoming submissions from researchers worldwide.

## Key Topics

- open-access
- peer-review

## Getting Started

- [Home](https://jmsr-online.com): Homepage for JMSR, a peer-reviewed academic journal for marketing and social research
- [Aim & Scope](https://jmsr-online.com/about/aim-and-scope): JMSR's aims, scope, and research topics in marketing and social research
- [Submit Article](https://jmsr-online.com/submit-article): JMSR article submission portal via Scholar Manuscript system

## Author & Submission Guidelines

- [For Authors](https://jmsr-online.com/policy/for-authors): JMSR author guidelines for manuscript submission and formatting
- [Peer Review Process](https://jmsr-online.com/policy/peer-review-process): JMSR peer review methodology and blind review process details
- [Article Processing Charges](https://jmsr-online.com/article-processing-charges): APC pricing and publication fee information for JMSR authors
- [Open Access Policy](https://jmsr-online.com/policy/open-access): JMSR open access policy with Creative Commons CC BY licensing

## Editorial & Peer Review

- [Editorial Board](https://jmsr-online.com/about/editorial-board): Editorial board members including Dr. M. Dhanabhakyam and other academic leaders
- [For Editors](https://jmsr-online.com/policy/for-editors): Editorial process guidelines for JMSR editors and managing staff
- [For Reviewers](https://jmsr-online.com/policy/for-reviewers): Peer review guidelines for JMSR reviewers following COPE standards

- [Propose a Special Issue](https://jmsr-online.com/special-issue/propose): Guidelines for proposing special issues to JMSR managing editor
